tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Search the Glyfiq medical and health icon library by keyword or medical term (for example 'cardiology', 'MRI', 'fracture', 'stethoscope'). tools.name: get_icon_svg
tools.description: Returns the full SVG source of one Glyfiq icon. Requires the exact icon name returned by search_icons. Free icons work without a key. tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: Returns the 50 most common tags in the Glyfiq library with counts, plus the total icon count. Use it to pick effective search terms before calling search_icons. Takes no parameters. Rare tags are not listed; use search_icons for those.

tools.name: get_free_icons_sample
tools.description: Returns a random selection of free Glyfiq icons (name and tags) so you can see what the library covers. This is not a search: use search_icons for a specific topic. No license key needed.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_icon_svg" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_tags" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
